_comment: Source script for generate_audio.py. Keys under 'vo' MUST match the LINES keys in js/main.js (the app falls back to phone TTS for any key with no clip). Edit freely — reword, add variants, change the name. Distances stay qualitative so lines can be pre-recorded. 'groans' are guttural sounds the app pitches DOWN in the browser to sound like zombies, so keep them low and wordless.

voice.note: A fixed seed keeps sampling stable but does NOT fix the timbre — pass a reference voice (--voice-ref or --reference-id) so every line is the SAME narrator. Pick a dry, unbothered voice for deadpan delivery.

start: Alright, Aida. Streets are clear, the dead are asleep. Try not to wake them. Off you go.
Morning. Statistically, most of them are still where you left them. Enjoy the warm-up while it lasts.
Comms are up. I'll be here, narrating your questionable life choices. Start running.
spawn: Company behind you, Aida. Not close yet. They seem motivated, though. Pity.
Something's noticed you. It's picking up the pace. Rude, really.
We've got followers. Nothing urgent. Just, you know, the dead. Keep moving.
ambush: Oh, that's a lot of them. Sprinters. Right behind you. Do the running thing. Now.
Ambush. They skipped the small talk. Aida, I'd move if I were you.
Well, they're fast. That's unfair. Sprint, Aida, sprint.
gap90: Ninety meters and gaining. Slowly. Embarrassing for everyone involved.
They're closing. Ninety meters. Plenty of time to panic efficiently.
gap60: Sixty meters. This would be an excellent time to actually try.
Sixty meters. I'm not saying hurry, but. Hurry.
gap30: Thirty meters. I'd run if I were you. I'm not. You are. Run.
Thirty meters. They can basically read your race number. Go.
close: That's close enough to smell them. You won't enjoy it. Move.
They're practically wearing you as a scarf. Kick.
escapeOutran: And they're gone. Turns out cardio pays off. Who knew. Well run, Aida.
You lost them. Somewhere back there they're deeply disappointed. Beautiful.
escapeTired: They've given up. Slumped in the road, like my expectations. You're clear.
And they quit. Dead, and still lazy. Off you go.
bitten: Well, that'll leave a mark. You're fine. Probably. Keep moving.
They got a nibble. Rude. Walk it off, Aida — briskly. Very briskly.
overrun: That's the horde, then. For what it's worth, you outran my expectations. Stroll home, Aida.
They got you. Anticlimactic, honestly. Head home, hero.
km: Another kilometer. The dead are keeping score. So am I.
That's another one down. Nobody's impressed. But well done, Aida.
finish: Home. Still breathing. Statistically remarkable. Let's see the damage.
You made it, Aida. I had money on the zombies. Pulling up the report.
